name: html-empty-flex-item-parent-axis-specificity
description: A childless, painted flex item reads its parent's main axis from the cascade winner, not the last matching rule. `div.row{flex-direction:row}` outranks a later `.row{flex-direction:column}` on specificity, so the browser lays the row out horizontally and the sizeless (width-less) divider keeps the row-axis zero-collapse box. Resolving the parent's declarations in source order read `column`, treated the divider's cross-axis `height` as a main-axis size, and dropped the compatibility class.

source_reference.notes: Product-neutral fixture: theme stylesheets often pair an element-qualified layout rule with a later, less specific utility override.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
